cases.name: Laura Katherine Poole Eastwood
cases.about: Her obituary said she was a member of FFA and had taken a technical class and was an excellent welder. She had attended Henderson and Madisonville Community Colleges. She was a beautiful and spontaneous person. The best times spent were times on a four wheeler, outdoors and being a country girl.
